name: Kallaway
inspiration: Kallaway-style premium dark creator explainer. Near-black cool canvas with a blue 'aurora' glow blooming from below; glassmorphism cards and pills; edge-lit neon frames; gradient glow text; focus-stack blur; smooth After-Effects easing (glide + bloom + breathe, never choppy). Palette is the AIS brand — blue is the hero glow where the references used purple. Reference frames in references/.
summary: Premium dark motion-graphics. Use for modern, high-engagement explainer content — tech, business, creator/marketing topics — where glowing glass UI, big gradient numbers, and cinematic depth carry the piece. The smooth, lit counterpart to Vox's paper-collage.

palette.notes: Dark cool canvas (#0A0E14 / deep #07121C), cream/white text, AIS blue hero glow, yellow secondary pop, red/orange punctuation. One saturated glow per beat. Mirrored in tokens.css.

fonts.notes: Plus Jakarta Sans (600-800) is the glow headline/number voice; Inter (400-600) is body/labels; Space Mono is data chips/timestamps/percentages. No serif.

motion: Smooth glide + bloom + breathe. Entrances fade up with power4.out/expo.out and a blur-in focus pull; glass cards spring with back.out(1.4); glow pulses softly (finite repeat+yoyo); aurora bloom drifts under content. Never choppy/stepped (that is Vox).
transitions: Soft scale + blur-out, gentle whips, dashed/solid connector lines that animate-draw. Never hard cuts or stepped slides.
